definitions.gloss: one after another, in succession, continuously
definitions.explanation: Events or things occurring or being done in rapid sequence without interruption.

examples.japanese: {問題|もんだい}が{次々|つぎつぎ}と{起|お}きた。
{新|あたら}しい{商品|しょうひん}が{次々|つぎつぎ}{発売|はつばい}された。
examples.english: New products were released one after another.

examples.japanese: {お客|きゃく}さんが{次々|つぎつぎ}と{来|き}た。

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
・{次々|つぎつぎ}と〜する (to do ~ one after another)
・{次々|つぎつぎ}に〜する (to do ~ in succession)

Both {次々|つぎつぎ}と and {次々|つぎつぎ}に are used interchangeably, though と may slightly emphasize the continuous nature.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{次々|つぎつぎ}: One after another (rapid succession)
・{続々|ぞくぞく}: One after another (similar meaning, often for people arriving)
・{相次|あいつ}いで: In succession, one after another (more formal)
